approved.en: US envoy Steve Witkoff met President Putin in Russia after a positive meeting with President Zelenskyy, and Russia freed jailed American Stephen Hubbard who had fought for Ukraine. Ukraine carried out its first drone airlift of a wounded soldier from the front line, while Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv in a late-night attack injuring six people. Russia also launched missiles that hit Kyiv after agreeing to a US call to resume peace talks, and Putin ordered the release of the American detainee during the meeting. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ukraina gjennomførte sin første drone-lufttransport av en såret soldat fra frontlinjen, mens russiske ballistiske missiler traff Kyiv i et nattlig angrep som såret seks personer. Russland avfyrte også missiler som traff Kyiv etter at de hadde gått med på en amerikansk oppfordring om å gjenoppta fredsforhandlingene, og Putin beordret løslatelsen av den amerikanske fangen under møtet. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and are moving toward the Eritrean border, while a pro-government militia says it seized the regional airport and reports Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to settle Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people, and the TPLF claims to have killed 1,511 Ethiopian soldiers in recent fighting. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA, gjennom utenriksminister Marco Rubio, oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å de-eskalere, og Mekelle borgermester Shishay Amare kunngjorde valg innen seks måneder for å løse Vest-Tigray gjennom konstitusjonelle prosesser.
